name: Okyrhoe
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the diameter JPL lists; not three measured axes.
credit: JPL Small-Body Database, physical parameters for 52872 Okyrhoe (1998 SG35): diameter 36 km; JPL's stated reference: urn:nasa:pds:neowise_diameters_albedos::2.0[centaurs] (http://adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013ApJ...773...22B)
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 36 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists for Okyrhoe. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no spin pole is published.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed colour or terrain.
introduction: Okyrhoe is a centaur, a small icy body orbiting the Sun among the giant planets.
card: A centaur orbiting among the giant planets.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 36 km diameter JPL lists. Its shape and pole are not measured.
